events.verdict: [Observable in enhanced video] Griffin (DET) never fully clears and is in the lane for longer than three seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
Drummond (DET) makes contact with the ball after it has reached its apex.
Harden (HOU) and Griffin (DET) briefly engage and disengage off ball during the screen.
[Observable in enhanced video] Griffin (DET) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Gordon (HOU) is not established in Bullock's (DET) path when he sets the screen, but he gives him room to avoid the contact.
Smith (DET) maintains a legal guarding position on Harden's (HOU) jump shot.
Harden (HOU) remains in bounds when he passes the ball after the deflection.
Galloway (DET) makes marginal contact with Paul's (HOU) arm when he splits the double team.
Drummond (DET) briefly engage and disengage with Harden (HOU) while setting the screen prior to the inbound.
Drummond (DET) has his arms extended when he sets the pick on Capela (HOU) but the contact is marginal.
Griffin (DET) turns and delivers the contact to Ennis (HOU), affecting his ability to defend the play.
Smith (DEN) commits a take foul on Harden (HOU).
Griffin (DET) extends his arm into Harden (HOU), but the contact is marginal and Harden is able to move through it.
Calderon (DET) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Paul (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position on Smith's (DET) jump shot.

LAR shows Harden (HOU) briefly places an arm around Galloway (DET) but immediately removes it when the two players engage. Harden does not drive through Galloway's space and cause him to fall to the floor.
Griffin (DET) makes incidental contact with Harden (HOU) prior to the inbound that does not cause him to fall to the floor.
Drummond (DET) commits a take foul on Harden (HOU).
Paul (HOU) makes contact with Griffin's (DET) arm during his shooting motion on his jump shot.
Griffin (DET) makes contact to Harden (HOU) during the rebound.
